title: Cookies and Cream Ice Cream Pie
changes_from_base: A baked crust of crushed sugar cones filled with vanilla ice cream mashed with chopped chocolate sandwich biscuits, instead of sponge layers.
summary: A crisp ice-cream-cone crust filled with chunky cookies-and-cream ice cream, topped with a cloud of whipped cream.

steps.title: Crust
steps.text: Process 12 sugar ice-cream cones to fine crumbs, about 30 s, then stir in 70 g melted butter and 25 g caster sugar until moistened.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Press the crumb mixture firmly over the base and up the sides of the pie dish and bake at 180 °C for 6-8 min until crisp, then cool completely on a rack, about 30 min.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Soften 950 ml vanilla ice cream in a bowl, add the chopped chocolate sandwich biscuits and mash together with the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Spread the ice cream mixture evenly into the cooled crust and press cling film onto the surface.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Freeze for at least 4 h until firm.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Cut into wedges and top each with a spoonful of whipped cream.

tips: Let the ice cream soften just enough to mix in the biscuits without turning it to liquid.
Press cling film directly onto the surface before freezing to stop ice crystals forming.
The baked crust can be made ahead and frozen for up to 1 month before filling.
storage: Covered well, the filled pie keeps in the freezer for up to 1 week.
